{"scores":[
  {"dimension":"Agentic systems architecture","note":"Mentions building with AI and making tools trustworthy, but gives no concrete agent architecture, guardrails, or infrastructure ownership.","score":1},
  {"dimension":"Narrative distinctiveness","note":"Has a distinctive, personal voice and a coherent through-line about security impact and quiet importance, though still fairly restrained.","score":3},
  {"dimension":"Platform leverage orientation","note":"Explicitly values small improvements to core security systems reaching an enormous surface, indicating shared tooling and compounding impact.","score":3},
  {"dimension":"Security assessment practice","note":"Lists Security+ and CTF participation, but does not describe hands-on security review, threat modeling, or remediation assessment work.","score":2},
  {"dimension":"Security engineering philosophy","note":"Conveys a clear philosophy that security tooling should make vulnerability response routine and enable quiet, dependable protection.","score":3},
  {"dimension":"Personal project ambition","note":"No substantial independent side project is described beyond tools and work-related software.","score":1},
  {"dimension":"Developer enablement orientation","note":"Frames the work around helping busy developer teams do the secure thing by default and reducing friction through proximity to users.","score":4},
  {"dimension":"Go depth","note":"Go is described as the main language used across 6 backend services, suggesting strong central use.","score":4},
  {"dimension":"Academic preparation","note":"Only a bachelor's degree is presented.","score":1},
  {"dimension":"Algorithmic fluency","note":"No concrete example of algorithmic or data-structure-driven improvement is provided.","score":1},
  {"dimension":"Role-specific fit","note":"The motivation is clearly tied to security engineering, backend work, and the team's mission to automate security processes, though not highly specific to the exact challenge.","score":3},
  {"dimension":"Offensive security practice","note":"Mentions playing capture-the-flag competitions when possible, but without depth or regularity details.","score":2},
  {"dimension":"Evidence specificity","note":"Provides some concrete evidence such as MIT, 3 years, 6 backend services, Go, Python, Security+, and CTFs, but little operational detail about outcomes.","score":3},
  {"dimension":"Open-source stewardship","note":"No open-source stewardship is mentioned.","score":1},
  {"dimension":"Applied AI production maturity","note":"Says the candidate shipped language-model features and learned to make them trustworthy, but gives no evaluation or hardening detail.","score":3},
  {"dimension":"Vulnerability triage automation","note":"Expresses interest in vulnerability response and automation, but gives no concrete example of intake, classification, routing, or deduplication tooling.","score":1},
  {"dimension":"Writing polish","note":"Clean, professional prose with no noticeable grammar or spelling issues.","score":4},
  {"dimension":"Security credential strength","note":"Lists CompTIA Security+, which is a baseline security credential.","score":2},
  {"dimension":"Python depth","note":"Python is described as being all over recent work and used for services and small tools, indicating regular production use.","score":3},
  {"dimension":"Security automation mission understanding","note":"Understands the role as making vulnerability response routine and scaling security work through tools, but does not mention triage or variant analysis in detail.","score":3},
  {"dimension":"Production software experience","note":"Three years maintaining and launching six backend services indicates solid production responsibility and breadth.","score":3},
  {"dimension":"Engineering rigor","note":"Emphasizes maintenance, trustworthiness, and making vulnerability response routine, reflecting a dependable-systems mindset.","score":3},
  {"dimension":"Collaboration and learning posture","note":"Explicitly says the role sits close to the people it serves and mentions collaborating with the team, but not specifically with security specialists.","score":3}
]}
